verdict.rationale: Claude gives users some data controls: individuals can export chat history and account data from Settings > Privacy, review, edit, or turn off memory, use incognito chats that are excluded from model improvement, and set a Model Improvement privacy setting. The evidence does not document retention periods or deleting conversations or accounts, so retention and deletion control is only partly shown. Missing for 10: explicit conversation/account deletion docs, configurable retention periods, documented retention timelines, independent corroboration.
